content: In case the nPdu feature is used for a socket connection and TriggerMode is set to TRIGGER_ALWAYS for the current PDU (SoAdPduRouteDest) and the resulting PDU data and headers don't exceed SoAdSocketnPduUdpTxBufferMin, SoAd shall transmit all PDUs stored for the socket connection (if any) and the current PDU by call ing TcpIp_UdpTransmit() .
